title: Hong Kong 100 – 2027 event home page
claims: The 2027 events are The Third on Thursday 21 January 2027 (34 km, 1,558 m, 10 hours), The Half on Friday 22 January 2027 (53 km, 2,263 m, 14 hours), HK100 on Saturday 23 January 2027 (100 km, 5,142 m, 30 hours) and The Grand Sam from 21 to 24 January 2027 (183 km, 8,963 m, 54 hours).
The HK100 is described as one of Asia's premier trail races, taking runners across Hong Kong's mountains, beaches, ridgelines and country parks.
The home page presents the 2027 edition as the upcoming edition.
